title: A-Pillar Speaker — SYNC 2/SYNC 3
introduction: The A-pillar speaker comes out of its trim panel after the panel is removed from beside the windshield. I think of the job as opening a small case: the panel has its own attachments, and the speaker has another set inside. Knowing which set you are releasing makes the drawing much more useful. This procedure covers vehicles with SYNC 2/SYNC 3, with separate coupe and convertible access routes.

items.name: Match the body style
items.detail: Choose the coupe or convertible trim-removal sequence before releasing the panel.

items.name: Read the illustrated configuration
items.detail: Both trim references show LHD, with RHD similar, and the RH side, with the LH side similar.

items.name: Complete the required safety review
items.detail: Before beginning this repair, carefully review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189), including its general service warnings. Review the safety references linked there for every listed system involved in your work before working on that system. Those applicable system references remain required reading; the precautions here do not replace them.

items.name: Prevent remote starting
items.detail: Before service requiring work underneath or around the vehicle, disable the remote start feature, if equipped, through the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, potentially causing personal injury or death.

items.name: Remove the key
items.detail: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from starting the engine during service. An accidental start may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Wear protective equipment
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to follow either precaution may result in serious personal injury.

edits.text:
Remove the A-Pillar trim panel using the reference that matches your body style.
Refer to: [A-Pillar Trim Panel - Convertible](#/document/G1692609) (501-05 Interior Trim and Ornamentation, Removal and Installation).
Refer to: [A-Pillar Trim Panel - Coupe](#/document/G1692599) (501-05 Interior Trim and Ornamentation, Removal and Installation).
edits.why: The speaker’s retaining tabs become accessible with the trim panel removed. On a convertible, remove the sun visor cap, release its clip, then remove the visor using the movement shown by the curved arrow. Disconnect the visor electrical connector if equipped. Release the A-pillar trim retainers, disconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, then release the clips and remove the panel in the illustrated direction. On a coupe, remove the pin-type retainer at the lower end of the door weatherstrip and position the weatherstrip aside. Release the trim clips and disconnect the tether anchor. Disconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, then release the remaining clips and remove the panel. I keep the coupe tether in mind here: the panel can be unclipped while still having an attachment to release.

edits.text: Release the retaining tabs highlighted in magenta around the A-Pillar speaker, then remove the speaker in the direction shown by the arrow on the blue component.
edits.why: The perimeter arrows identify the tab-release movements; the arrow on the speaker identifies the component’s removal movement. I read these separately so the drawing explains both what holds the speaker and how it comes free.

edits.text: Install by reversing removal: refit the A-Pillar speaker into the trim panel and engage its retaining tabs, then reinstall the panel and the access parts for your body style.
edits.why: I check that the speaker is retained by its tabs before refitting the panel. On a convertible, engage the panel clips, reconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, and secure the panel retainers. Reconnect the visor electrical connector if equipped, refit the visor, engage its clip, and reinstall the cap. On a coupe, engage the panel clips, reconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, reconnect the tether anchor and engage the remaining clips. Reposition the door weatherstrip and reinstall the pin-type retainer. The finished assembly restores the connections and attachments opened for access, including the coupe tether or convertible visor hardware.
